jobs.name: scan demo
jobs.prompt: Realistic overhead photo of an open high-school biology textbook page lying on a light oak desk, shot from directly above with a phone, soft natural window light from the left. The page is titled 'Mitosis: How Cells Divide' in a bold sans-serif heading, followed by a short paragraph of body text, then a clean labeled diagram of the four phases of mitosis in a row (Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, Telophase) with small cell illustrations, then two more short paragraphs and a highlighted key-term box reading 'Key term: Cytokinesis - the division of the cytoplasm'. A yellow highlighter lies diagonally across the bottom right corner of the page. Sharp, legible, realistic print texture, slight page curl at the edge.
